stem: What is the greatest integer \(x\) for which \(7x - 4 < 45\)?
solution: The inequality is strict, so 7 itself does not work. The greatest integer less than 7 is 6.
verify:
x = symbols('x')
S = solve_univariate_inequality(7*x - 4 < 45, x, relational=False)
assert S == Interval.open(-oo, 7)
greatest = max(n for n in range(-50, 50) if n in S)
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [greatest] == [6]
